en.title: 2. Category & Division Setup
en.excerpt: Learn how to configure competition divisions, bow styles, age groups, shooting distances, and participant quotas for your tournament.

toc.text: 4. Bow Disciplines, Age Groups & Team Formats

en.content:
1. Understanding Tournament Categories

In archery competitions, athletes are grouped into distinct divisions according to their equipment (bow style), age group, and gender. In Archeris, each category operates as an independent competition bracket with its own qualification scoreboard, elimination tree, and podium awards.

2. Category Dashboard & Filtering

To view and manage your tournament divisions:

  1. Go to Organizer Dashboard > Tournaments and open your championship.
  2. Click Categories in the left sidebar navigation (/dashboard/organizer/tournaments/[id]/categories).
  3. Here you will see all created divisions, participant counts, team sizes, and category status (Active or Draft).
  4. Use the top dropdown filters (Filter Bow and Team Type) to quickly locate specific divisions when managing large multi-day championships.

3. Adding a New Competition Division

To add a division to your tournament:

  1. Click the bright yellow + Add Category button in the top header.
  2. Select your target configuration parameters from the popup window:
    • Bow Type: Choose the archery discipline (Recurve, Compound, Barebow, or Standard Bow).
    • Age Group: Select the age bracket (U-10, U-12, U-15, U-18, Senior / Umum, Masters 50+, or Custom Age).
    • Team Type: Choose between Individual (1 person), Team (3 archers of same gender), or Mixed Team (1 male + 1 female).
    • Gender Division: Select Men (Putra), Women (Putri), or Mixed (Campuran).
  3. Click Add Category to immediately create the division.

4. Bow Disciplines, Age Groups & Team Formats

Archeris adheres to standardized World Archery and national federation standards:

  • Olympic Recurve: Standard 70m for Seniors, with scaled distances (10m–50m) for youth age brackets.
  • Compound: Standard 50m with 80cm 6-ring center target faces.
  • Barebow: Standard 50m with full 122cm target face and no sights/stabilizers.
  • Standard / Traditional Bow: Popular national development divisions using wooden risers and limb standards.

5. Quota Limits & Category Capacity

You can set a Max Participants quota for each category (e.g., 32 or 64 slots) to ensure you do not exceed physical target capacity on the shooting line:

  • Live Quota Tracking: The system automatically decrements remaining slots as participants complete online payment.
  • Sold Out Protection: Once the maximum quota is reached, public registration for that category will automatically show a Full indicator, preventing overbooking.
